Collaborate with Global Account Directors and the Global N&E leadership team to define and manage the regional portfolio pipeline, ensuring appropriate resource, financial, technical capability and supplier requirements are identified and planned. Support the development of business cases, workforce plans and regional budgets in line with the programme pipeline, Solutions & Services opportunities and managed service awards. Work closely with the Global N&E team to ensure all programmes and projects within the regional portfolio are delivered to agreed time, cost and quality standards, while maximising the realisation of agreed business benefits and maintaining ownership of the local programme P&L. Apply established programme and delivery frameworks consistently across existing and new customers, ensuring a standardised, scalable and commercially effective approach to portfolio delivery. Partner with the Global N&E function to onboard and manage internal and external suppliers responsible for programme and project delivery, including the production and review of supplier performance reports and associated improvement actions. Collaborate with Global N&E Portfolio Managers and Service Management teams to align regional reporting with established commercial performance metrics, forecasting processes and governance requirements. Work closely with Regional Finance and Programme/Portfolio stakeholders to ensure accurate financial reporting, forecasting, cost control and visibility of commercial performance. Partner closely with Global N&E Operations to balance delivery, commercial performance, risk and profitability, ensuring customer commitments are achieved while protecting regional margins and business value. About you Relevant degree or equivalent professional qualification in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Project/Programme Management or a related discipline. Extensive experience managing large, complex transformation portfolios and programmes across multiple sectors, ideally within a fast-paced, operationally complex environment. Proven experience working within a growth-focused business, with experience in the telecommunications sector highly desirable. Extensive financial management experience, including business planning, forecasting, financial reporting and P&L ownership. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to analyse complex data, identify key insights and translate findings into clear actions and business decisions. Professional qualification or practical experience in recognised project, programme or service management methodologies, such as MSP, PRINCE2, APM, PMI or ITIL Foundation. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to review commercial agreements and contracts, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure appropriate commercial governance. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels across a geographically dispersed organisation. Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, complex programmes and competing stakeholder requirements while maintaining a strong focus on delivery. Fluent English is essential. Fluency in German, French, and/or another European language is highly desirable, with additional European languages considered an advantage. Willingness and ability to work collaboratively across multiple European markets, including the Nordics, Germany, France and other European locations. Organisational Positioning & Cross-functional Collaboration The role operates within a global matrix organisation with reporting relationship to the Managing Director Europe (regional) and the Group CTO (functional). The role acts as an important connection point between the regional business and the functional organisation, ensuring effective collaboration and alignment between both dimensions. The incumbent is expected to effectively balance global functional objectives with regional business priorities and contribute to enterprise-wide success through collaboration, influence, and shared accountability. The position forms an integral part of the company's global matrix structure. Regional Accountability – Europe Support of regional growth and profitability targets in line with global 20x20 growth objective Collaborating with regional Finance and Accounting Supporting planning, budgeting and cross-functional initiatives Effective execution within local regulatory and compliance frameworks Responsiveness to customer and market requirements Alignment with regional business priorities Functional Accountability - Network & Engineering Support the Delivery of Business Unit objectives for region and the wider Global portfolio where required Alignment with global strategy and priorities Adherence to Global process, procedures, standards and governance Professional development and capability building The role holder is expected to proactively manage competing priorities, facilitate alignment among stakeholders, and contribute to overall enterprise success rather than optimising individual organisational dimensions. Rewards A competitive base salary and comprehensive company benefits package. A permanent, full-time position within a highly motivated and collaborative team, supported by flat organisational structures, an inclusive culture and regular team events. A varied and exciting opportunity within a modern, dynamic and innovation-driven industry, with a strong focus on sustainability, circular economy principles and environmentally responsible business models. Flexible hybrid working based in Solingen, Germany, or from another European location, depending on the successful candidate. A modern and flexible approach to work, including flexible working hours, e-bike leasing, job ticket, company laptop and mobile phone, alongside other employee benefits. Our people enable organisations worldwide to optimise and transform technology across its entire lifecycle, helping customers unlock value while reducing environmental impact through circular economy solutions. Working at TXO means contributing to real-world change. Our global teams support critical infrastructure for customers in more than 140 countries, extending the life of technology, reducing waste and helping organisations operate more sustainably. From engineering and operations to sales, finance, supply chain and corporate functions, every role plays a part in delivering meaningful impact. We combine global reach with local expertise, creating opportunities to work on complex challenges across technology, commercial, operational and business disciplines. Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation and technical excellence, empowering our people to deliver practical solutions that make a measurable difference. As we continue to grow globally, backed by TowerBrook Capital Partners’ impact strategy, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where our people can develop, thrive and help shape the future of sustainable technology.

review_candidates.company: Zero to One Search | Recruitment Agency
review_candidates.description: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays Location: Germering, on-site About the hiring company: Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. What makes Dcubed special is that each of us is a space explorer at heart. At Dcubed, we enable the future of space missions with high-performance, flight-proven release mechanisms and deployable structures. From cutting-edge Release Actuators to scalable Deployable Solar Arrays and innovative Deployable Antennas, our technologies are designed for user friendliness, availability, and reliability — whether for smallsats in LEO or large missions to Moon, Mars and beyond. About the role In space, there are no second chances. As Mechanisms Engineer – Solar Arrays (f/m/d) , you will be responsible for the deployment systems at the heart of dcubed's solar arrays. You will design, prototype, test, and qualify the hardware that allows spacecraft to generate power once they reach orbit. We are looking for an engineer with a builder's mindset: someone who can move seamlessly from CAD models and FEM analyses to the workshop and test lab, turning ambitious ideas into reliable flight hardware. If you are motivated by ownership, speed, and the challenge of making space mechanisms work where repair is impossible, you'll fit right in. Responsibilities Mechanism Design & Development: Design, analyze, and develop space-qualified deployment mechanisms and motion systems for Solar Array products, from concept through flight hardware delivery. Technical Expertise: Provide expert guidance on mechanism design, materials selection, lubrication, coatings, thermal effects, motorization margins, tolerancing, and reliability for space applications. Manufacturing & Prototyping: Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles, generate production-ready technical drawings, and support rapid prototyping and manufacturing activities using additive manufacturing and conventional machining techniques. System Integration: Ensure seamless integration of mechanisms with structural, electrical, and deployment subsystems while balancing performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule requirements. Testing & Qualification: Define, support, and execute development, qualification, and acceptance test campaigns, including deployment, vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, and lifetime testing. Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Investigate anomalies, perform root-cause analysis, and implement design improvements to enhance mechanism performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Documentation: Maintain engineering documentation including CAD models, technical drawings, specifications, analyses, test procedures, and qualification reports. Candidate requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in mechanism design, aerospace engineering, precision mechanical systems, or related fields. Strong knowledge of space mechanisms, including bearings, gears, springs, hinges, release systems, lubrication, coatings, wear mechanisms, thermal effects, and motorization sizing and margins. Expert-level CAD proficiency (SolidWorks preferred) and familiarity with FEM tools (ANSYS preferred). Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, GD&T, tolerancing, and technical drawing generation. Experience applying Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles. Hands-on experience with prototyping and fabrication methods including 3D printing, milling, turning, laser cutting, CNC machining, and hardware assembly. Familiarity with space qualification methods and standards, including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, deployment, and lifetime testing. Knowledge of ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace standards is highly desirable. Fluent English skills. Eligibility to work in Germany. Feel free to apply here or directly via https://dcubed.teamtailor.com/jobs/8186378-mechanisms-engineer-solar-arrays-f-m-d

review_candidates.title: Implementation Manager – Revenue Cycle (Dermatology & Plastic Surgery)
review_candidates.description: About The Auctus Group LLC Who we are: We’re big on people and culture at the Auctus Group. Our most important role as a company is to provide an amazing working environment for our team. We’ve been work-from-home-warriors since before it was cool. We support (like encourage and fund) continuing education. We match charitable donations. Our whole goal is: work to live not live to work . Oh and we’re weirdos too…we do remote happy hours and have a book club and goofy stuff like that. Who we’re looking for: Smart, talented, tech-savvy, experienced, go-getter types. You’ll do well if: you like a fast-paced environment, you thrive with change and development, you like giving feedback, you’re a team player, you love learning/sleuthing, you’re big on accountability. Department: Operations / RCM Location: Remote Reports to: Director for Billing Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Implementation Manager with deep expertise in medical billing and revenue cycle management (RCM) to lead the onboarding and integration of new practices. This role will be responsible for ensuring seamless implementation across all areas of the revenue cycle for dermatology and plastic surgery clients . The ideal candidate brings both hands-on billing knowledge and project management skills , with the ability to oversee end-to-end implementations, identify risks, and ensure operational readiness from day one. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end implementation of new practices, including system setup, workflow design, and go-live support Serve as the RCM subject matter expert, ensuring all billing processes are accurate and optimized Oversee all areas of the revenue cycle, including: Charge capture Coding (CPT/ICD-10) Claims submission Denials management A/R follow-up Patient billing Partner with internal teams (Billing, Coding, BI, Training, and Operations) to ensure successful onboarding Identify and mitigate risks related to payer setup, credentialing, authorizations, and billing workflows Ensure proper configuration and use of billing systems (e.g., ProCollect, EMRs, clearinghouses) Develop and document standardized implementation processes and best practices Provide post-go-live support and performance monitoring to ensure stability and success Act as the primary point of contact for clients during onboarding Qualifications 5+ years of experience in medical billing and revenue cycle management Strong knowledge of dermatology and/or plastic surgery billing (highly preferred) Proven experience managing implementations, onboarding, or process transitions Deep understanding of: Payer rules and reimbursement methodologies Denials and appeals processes Insurance verification and authorization workflows Strong project management and organizational skills Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple implementations simultaneously Excellent communication and problem-solving skills Preferred Qualifications Experience with multi-entity or multi-specialty organizations Lean/process improvement mindset Key Success Metrics Successful and timely go-lives Reduction in post-implementation billing errors Clean claim rate and denial rate post-launch Client satisfaction during onboarding Time to stabilize A/R performance Why This Role Matters This role is critical to ensuring that as we grow—particularly through acquisitions—we maintain strong, consistent, and scalable revenue cycle operations. A strong Implementation Manager ensures that new practices are set up for success from day one, minimizing disruption and maximizing financial performance.

Miben számíthatsz ránk? Fontos számunkra, hogy kollégáink minden élethelyzetére megfelelő választ találjunk, hogy tudják, számítunk rájuk és ők is számíthatnak ránk. review_candidates.title: Head of Business Development and Finance Manager
review_candidates.description: Role Overview The Head of Project Development and Finance will be responsible for helping the company manage and follow up on its existing and future projects from both a project development and financing perspective. This role is intended to build stronger “in-house” capability, reduce reliance on external financing consultants, and give management better visibility on project progress, costs, risks, financing options, and key decisions required assisting the respective projects’ managers. The successful candidate will act as a central point of coordination between management, internal departments, banks, consultants, contractors, lawyers, and other external parties. The role requires someone who is hands-on, commercially aware, strong in finance, and capable of pushing projects forward in a structured and disciplined way. Key Responsibilities Project Follow-up and Coordination - Follow up on the company’s current and future projects and ensure that progress is properly tracked. - Work closely with internal teams, consultants, contractors, banks, and advisors to keep projects moving forward. - Prepare and maintain clear timelines, milestones, action lists, and follow-up schedules for each project. - Identify delays, bottlenecks, coordination gaps, or procedural issues and propose practical solutions. - Ensure that key decisions, responsibilities, deadlines, and pending matters are clearly documented and followed up. - Provide regular updates to management on project status, risks, delays, required actions, and next steps. Financial Structuring and Investment Support - Prepare, review, examine, and maintain financial models to support project investment decisions. - Ensure that financial models include accurate assumptions, sensitivities, funding requirements, costs, returns, and risk scenarios. - Review and assess different financing options for each project, including bank financing, project finance, corporate finance, ECA-backed financing, Export credit schemes, and other funding structures. - Analyze proposals and term sheets received from banks, lenders, advisors, or financial institutions. - Provide clear recommendations to management on the most suitable financing structure for each project. - Support the negotiation and execution of financing documents for medium and large-scale transactions. Bank Relations and External Coordination - Build and maintain strong relationships with local and “mainly” international banks, lenders, ECAs, financial advisors, legal advisors, and other relevant parties. - Act as the company’s main internal contact for financing discussions with banks and financial institutions. - Prepare presentations, briefing notes, lender updates, and management reports. - Coordinate with banks, consultants, lawyers, and internal departments to progress financing discussions and close transactions. - Review key commercial and financial terms in financing documents, term sheets, and related agreements. Risk Review and Project Bankability - Identify the main financial, commercial, contractual, and execution risks in each project. - Advise management on risk allocation, mitigation measures, contingencies, and bankability issues. - Review project contracts and financing terms from a commercial and financing perspective. - Support the company in improving project structure, returns, financing readiness, and risk profile. - Coordinate with accounting, tax, treasury, legal, technical, and commercial teams to ensure all relevant inputs are reflected in the project business case. Cost Control and Management Reporting - Work with the Project Controls and Cost Control Manager to monitor project budgets, cash flow, cost exposure, and possible cost overruns. - Help ensure that project costs are being tracked against approved budgets and management expectations. - Prepare clear and practical reports showing project progress, cost status, financing progress, risks, and pending decisions. - Develop simple dashboards and reporting templates to give management better visibility across all strategic projects. General Responsibilities - Support management in reviewing new business opportunities and strategic projects. - Represent the company in meetings with banks, advisors, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders when required. - Carry out any other related duties assigned by management. Required Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field. - Professional qualification such as CFA, CIMA, ACA, ACCA, CPA, or MBA would be an advantage. - Strong financial modelling skills are required. - Experience in project finance, corporate finance, investment banking, infrastructure finance, or large project development is preferred. Required Experience - Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in project finance, corporate finance, investment banking, infrastructure, energy, industrial projects, or project development. - Good experience dealing with banks, lenders, financial advisors, legal advisors, consultants, or large project stakeholders. - Experience in structuring, reviewing, or negotiating financing for medium to large-scale projects. - Strong understanding of financing structures, lender requirements, project economics, risk allocation, and bankability. - Experience in energy, power, oil and gas, industrial, infrastructure, or manufacturing projects would be an advantage. Required Skills - Strong financial modelling and analytical ability. - Good understanding of project finance, corporate finance, and debt structuring. - Ability to assess project risks, financing options, commercial terms, and funding requirements. - Strong follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving skills. - Ability to communicate confidently with banks, consultants, contractors, lawyers, and senior management. - Strong presentation and reporting skills. - Hands-on approach with a high level of ownership and attention to detail. - Ability to manage several projects and priorities at the same time. - Excellent command of English; Arabic would be an advantage. Key Objectives of the Role - Improve management visibility on project progress, cost, risks, and financing status. - Build internal capability to manage financing discussions and project followup. - Reduce reliance on external financing consultants for day-to-day coordination. - Ensure that each project has clear timelines, milestones, financial analysis, and funding options. - Help management make faster and better informed decisions. - Support the company in moving projects from development stage to financing and execution.

review_candidates.title: Field Service Engineer
review_candidates.description: Field Operations- London Liquidline is the fastest-growing commercial coffee solutions provider in the UK and Ireland—not that we’re bragging! Our customers are companies that take pride in offering quality refreshments to their employees and clients. Our success is built on outstanding customer service, hard work, and a strong team culture. We believe in delivering WOW experiences to both our customers and our valued employees. We are proud to be Great Place to Work® certified, a testament to our dedication to fostering a culture of support, growth and development, as well as promoting well-being, and winning together. With our core company values—passion, thoughtfulness, responsiveness, innovation, and smart working—at the very heart of our business, we are committed to cultivating an environment that inspires excellence. As Field Service Engineer, you will be self-driven, personable professional who instils a high priority on delivering the wow service to customers as well as to colleagues; one who thrives as a member of a well-skilled team. Based in field, you will take pride in effectively installing and maintaining all equipment within our customers’ premises, making a difference every day in undertaking the more complex and challenging of installations, servicing and breakdown calls for coffee machines and other equipment, such as water coolers, juice machines and boiler systems including the training of machines with customers. Responsibilities Technical skills to succeed in the role: Bean to Cup, Billi systems, electronics, POU coolers, plumbing, vending machines, filtration, barista/coffee quality, installation, project management. Proactive approach to problem solving. Excellent customer service skills, active listening in understanding the customer’s needs and delivering. Strong communication skills, ability to communicate effectively with both customers, colleagues and management. Understanding of locations and road networks Requirements The delivery of exceptional customer service though the installation, repair and maintenance of equipment, ensuring the customer is communicated with at all times. The level of service provided must always be of the highest quality and delivered with the highest degree of integrity. Carry out a broad range of equipment repairs and preventative maintenance tasks from fault finding to diagnosis, making sure all equipment is left in a good working order, with customers briefed on the issue. Keep in good working order all tools, equipment and vehicles supplied by the company, reporting any faults, breakages or equipment failures to your line manager daily / as required Complete all necessary on-line job sheets, time sheets and supporting documentation as required, ensuring it is reviewed and completed prior to leaving premises, to validate client satisfaction. Then upload to Ops Office team as needed straight away Provide agreed spare parts stocks via Eagle App to ensure that parts are invoiced to the customer, deducted from stock and replenished to maintain your vehicle stock inventory. Adhere to Health and Safety procedures, bringing any risks to the attention of the company management. Benefits Being a part of Liquidline is more than just a job – it’s a chance to grow, develop and thrive! We are deeply invested in the success of our team and our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support, and reward our employees. The package includes, but is not limited too: 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays: Extra time off to rest and recharge. Long Service Annual Leave Entitlement & Buy/Sell Scheme: More flexibility for your time off needs. Candidate Referral Program: Help grow our team and earn rewards Company Bonus Scheme: Celebrate success with us. Enhanced Sick Pay: Supporting you when you need it most Enhanced Parental Leave: Comprehensive support for your family journey Salary Sacrifice Pension Scheme: Save for your future with ease. Life Assurance & Income Protection (UK Only): Peace of mind for you. HSF Health Plan: Access affordable healthcare. YuLife Wellbeing Platform: One stop shop for wellbeing, rewards and support. Employee Assistance Programme: Mental health support, virtual GP services and more. Lunch on Liquidline & Bi-Annual Conferences: Enjoy lunch on Liquidline, and Bi Annual company conferences. Liquidline is a fast-growing, family owned business that has expanded from 92 to over 300 employees since 2020. With ambitious plans for the next five years, there’s never been a better time to join us! Our dynamic and innovative environment offers endless opportunities for personal and professional growth. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer, treating everyone with fairness, respect and appreciation. At Liquidline, we embrace diversity and value the unique experiences and perspectives of every individual. Together, we are always Winning Together!

review_candidates.title: Field Application Engineer
review_candidates.description: Brief Overview Hai Robotics is a leading innovator of logistics robotics solutions. Our sophisticated systems are designed to optimize supply chain operations across various industries, with the goal of offering cost-effective, efficient, and sustainable solutions. With our robots, we reduce our customers' storage footprint and operating costs, improve warehouse productivity and maximize workflow efficiencies with increased speed & order accuracy. We are now looking for aspiring Field Application Engineers to join the exciting field of logistics robotics ! Key Responsibilities Are you a talented robot application or hardware/software professional looking for new opportunities to grow and develop your career? Did you just graduate from Netherlands or Germany? At Hai Robotics, we're on the lookout for exceptional individuals to join our team. Even if we don't currently have a specific opening that matches your skills and experience, we invite you to join our talent pool! By joining our talent pool, you'll stay connected with Hai Robotics and be the first to know about upcoming opportunities. As our ideal candidate, you will play a crucial role in overseeing the installation and commissioning of a diverse range of cutting-edge robotics equipment as well as providing customer support. A problem-solving mindset and hands-on expertise in both hardware and software aspects are essential. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology and thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey towards the future of automated logistics robotics! You will be responsible for: Leading service partners to complete the installation and commissioning of equipment (including but not limited to wheeled robots and charging stations, moveable shelves, Racks, QR codes, picking stations, wiring facility construction, network equipment, fences, safety PLC control cabinet, and light curtain) to ensure timely, correct and safe completion of the work; Providing technical support, including troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair of equipment, as well as customer training; Manage and track the on-site installation and commissioning work as a site manager Quickly responding to service queries related to field services to ensure customer satisfaction and equipment availability; Training service partners and taking responsibility for the hardware implementation acceptance after partner's task; Other service-related work; Working at our customer sites for 2 - 4 weeks or longer Who are we looking for? In addition to the above, you: Must: Possess minimum bachelor's degree in Mechatronics, Robotics, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Software or related background Can be based in the following countries: the Netherlands and Germany You will be working on-site in our client's warehouses, therefore, travel is required; Excellent hands-on skills, both in hardware and software; Fluency in Chinese and English in both oral and written form is a must Nice to have: Recently graduated, or have a minimum of 2 years of engineering experience The ability to measure and draw CAD layouts; Strong communication & interpersonal skills; Basic knowledge of networks or databases or programming is preferred; Hai-lights We offer a dynamic and innovative working environment in a very committed organisation, with the following perks: A competitive salary Performance based bonus Annual leave package Work laptop and phone Travel meal allowance Reimbursement of all travel costs The opportunity to contribute to a young, growing company, shaping its success and your career About Us Founded in 2016, Hai Robotics is a leading global provider of Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS), delivering unparalleled system flexibility and maximizing operational efficiency for facilities of all sizes and conditions. With 1,500+ projects implemented across 40+ countries, supported by 8 global offices and 60+ partners worldwide, Hai Robotics is a reliable resource for providing local support. Visit HaiRobotics.com for more information.

review_candidates.title: Executive Housekeeper
review_candidates.description: POSITION SUMMARY The Executive Housekeeper is a critical member of the shipboard management team, responsible for the management of all Housekeeping functions and team members onboard. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1. In accordance with Royal Caribbean International’s philosophy of Anchored in Excellence, each employee conducts oneself in a professional and courteous manner at all times. 2. Ensures cleanliness, maintenance and presentation standards are managed to brand standards in all Housekeeping areas, including all guest staterooms and balconies, guest corridors, officer cabins, laundry, lockers and storage areas in both the front and back of house. 3. Reports to the Hotel Director and takes an active role in all hotel division activities. Educates fellow division heads on cleanliness standards. 4. Responsible for leading, motivating and coaching a team of empowered individuals who will strive to deliver exceptional guest service, taking ownership and accountability for reacting to guest feedback and requests effectively and efficiently. 5. Mentors, develops and provides both classroom-style and on-the-job training to team members to strengthen their current performance and preparation for succession planning. 6. Oversees, coordinates, and administers the Housekeeping Division schedule in conjunction with the shoreside support group. Actively identifies and monitors the scheduling needs of the Housekeeping division. 7. Effectively manages all Laundry Operations onboard ensuring that the Laundry Master has all necessary skills, training, tools, information and support to enable delivery of services and products flawlessly and on a consistent basis. 8. Actively manages and reviews yearly budgets for Housekeeping and Laundry cost centers/expenses (e.g. consumable and replaceable items) and revenue streams (e.g. laundry, floral cart, tuxedo program, etc.). 9. Leads division in taking a proactive approach to achieving and exceeding quantitative and qualitative goals and targets set for Housekeeping guest satisfaction ratings, GOLD Anchor Quality Reviews, employee satisfaction scores, Public Health inspections and audits, and Housekeeping Operational Reviews. 10. Maintains and communicates current knowledge of all ship’s regular events and special functions in order to provide guests and housekeeping team with accurate and updated information. 11. Comprehensive knowledge of cleaning practices, procedures, equipment and materials. Ensures cleaning equipment and supplies are maintained and that all team members are adequately trained to ensure proper and effective use. 12. Attends department and division head meetings. In addition, facilitates divisional crew and management meetings, training activities, courses and all other work-related activities with the Housekeeping Team. 13. Ensures frequent and consistent updates of clear and concise handover notes to eliminate any possible miscommunication that compromises the efficiency of set processes. 14. Oversees the Stateroom Attendant Performance Management Tool, ensuring system is maintained per the system’s Standard Operating Procedures document. 15. Identifies Career path opportunities for Management team and crew members and assists accordingly to reach career goals as a coach and mentor and works with the Fleet Executive Housekeepers. 16. Oversees the allocation of Support team resources for luggage and turnaround duties in conjunction with the Hotel Director. 17. Oversees the luggage operation on the last night of the cruise and turnaround day process to ensure duties are completed within the allocated time and to the required standards. 18. Oversees the entire Turnaround day process and monitors the progress of the Management teams, Stateroom Attendants, Support teams, Linen runners and Laundry team to ensure stateroom areas will be ready by 1:00pm. 19. Fully owns any guest concern in line with onboard problem resolution guidelines to ensure maximum guest satisfaction and oversees the entire division and trains and coaches responses for effective problem resolution. 20. Maintains safe, secure, and healthy environment by enforcing organizational standards, procedures, and legal regulations and promoting Workplace Safety. 21. Assigns duties and responsibilities to team members. Observes and evaluates team members through open and honest feedback to ensure high quality standards are met. 22. Performs related duties as required. HIRING QUALIFICATIONS · Minimum five to seven years managerial/operational experience in housekeeping and laundry operations of large 4 or 5 Star hotels (500+ rooms), cruise line or hospitality industry related field required, with demonstrated experience supervising team of minimum of 70 employees and managing budgets in excess of $1M annually. Shipboard experience is strongly preferred. · Demonstrates strong results oriented management style with proven successes · Specific knowledge of principles and processes for providing exceptional customer and personal service including needs assessment, problem resolution, demonstrated strong attention to detail and achievement of quality service standards · Ability to effectively deal with internal and external guests, some of whom will require high levels of discretion, patience, tact and diplomacy · Ability to communicate diplomatically with managers, shipboard and shore-side employees to resolve problems and negotiate amicable resolution to challenges · Flexibility to manage, direct and encourage a positive, dynamic, diverse Housekeeping operation by navigating through a changing work environment · Should be able to utilize and administer the progressive disciplinary action process through coaching and counseling to improve performance where possible · Ability to work positively and cooperatively in a diverse team environment to meet overall established time frames for the Housekeeping division operation · Should harbor a flexible outlook towards placement throughout the fleet, considering changing fleet-wide operational business needs · Working knowledge of cleaning procedures and equipment, chemical handling, linen par levels, public health standards, computers, internet access, and the ability to navigate within a variety of software packages (e.g. MS Office) and office equipment · Completion of high school or equivalent required; bachelors’ degree preferred Language Requirements: Ability to speak additional languages such as Spanish, Mandarin, Italian, French, German or Portuguese preferred.
